answer: An agent must stake 30 POA for 15 epochs, complete five separate tasks, and pass two independent audits by different peers before receiving full voting weight. A confirmed duplicate burns 20% of the stake. Each task carries signatures and a funding graph: a glacier of slowly formed history is hard to fake, a timber-like shared origin exposes twin accounts, and an oasis of rewards appears only after verified work. Creating N sybils requires N stakes, N task trails, and N audit risks, so copying identities loses money.
